text:
rachel (PM): Customers confused: "Save for route" sometimes shows Org badge and disables edits. Need API -> console mapping fixed before Friday deploy.

alex (eng): We conflated owner vs origin. Backend returns owner=org even for copied route presets.

ken (platform): Proposal: add flat fields `editable_by` and `provenance` plus `preview_cost_tokens`. Keep `owner` for 30d. Will add `X-Presets-Schema:v2-preview` header.

nina (design): UX: show "Inherited" badge when provenance==org_default with tooltip "Managed at Org Defaults" and a link to edit. For overrides show "Overrides Org Default".

sam (sre): Telemetry: expand `preset.save` events with `prev_effective_id`, `new_effective_id`, `provenance`, `preview_cost_delta`. Alert if delta > 15%.

rachel (PM): Action items: ken PR today, alex add client mapping + flag, nina tooltip copy, sam alert rule. Quick 10m sync tomorrow.
